blocks.text: Read the chapter with this setting in view: Matthew 19 preserves disputed divorce exception language and a threefold eunuch saying within teaching on marriage, children, and discipleship. It gives a starting point for following the chapter's own movement. The chapter itself should determine how far the point is taken. A more precise reconstruction remains disputed.

A literary feature to notice is that Five repeated discourse-ending formulas organize large teaching collections without proving one universally accepted symbolic outline. This form helps organize the chapter's claims. Notice it before drawing broader conclusions from a single phrase or image. Interpretations differ on some details.
